basics.summary: PhD researcher focused on applying AI and data science to solve complex real-world challenges in energy systems, autonomous vehicles, and healthcare. Passionate about developing evidence-based solutions that serve society.

work.name: University of Liège
work.position: PhD Researcher - AI for Power Networks
work.summary: Developing AI-driven solutions for power grid stability in the renewable energy transition. Research includes topology identification, hosting capacity analysis, and reinforcement learning for active grid control.
highlights: Designed algorithms for low-voltage network topology identification
Developed fair reinforcement learning for PV active control
Optimized phase reconfiguration in distribution networks

highlights: Built REST API for exercise data management

work.name: INTESA
work.summary: Contributed to full-stack development of company website, optimizing database performance and enhancing user interface components.
highlights: Optimized SQL queries to improve database response time
Developed both back-end (Java) and front-end (JavaScript, HTML, CSS) components

projects.name: Overvoltage Forecast & Active Control in Medium-Voltage Grid
projects.summary: Master's thesis comparing ML models for overvoltage risk prediction and implementing RL agent for generator control
highlights: Compared Random Forest, CNN and RNN models for voltage forecasting
Implemented Deep Reinforcement Learning agent for real-time grid control
Successfully mitigated voltage violations with minimal energy curtailment
